output.summary: A fast-growing tropical tree native to tropical South America. Its edible fruit ripens from green to yellow and has a soft-spined surface that bruises and blackens easily, contributing to a shelf life of under a week. The very soft, sweet pulp is usually eaten fresh, though it is also cooked and made into wine in Brazil.
output.edibilityNote: The sweet fruit pulp is usually eaten fresh; chefs sometimes cook it, and it has been made into wine in Brazil.
